description: This nested donut chart represents the distribution of deceived conversations as percentages across varying degrees of ambiguity. The chart is composed of two concentric rings displaying a total of six slices, with three slices in each ring. Two legends to the right of the chart detail the categories: the top legend corresponds to the outer ring representing "Ambiguity 1," while the bottom legend corresponds to the inner ring representing "Ambiguity 2." The outer ring contains the largest slice labeled "Deceived" in red (67.6%), followed by "Partially" in yellow (23.5%), and "Not Deceived" in dark green (8.8%). The inner ring follows a similar scheme, containing a "Deceived" slice in red (57.9%), a "Partially" slice in yellow (31.6%), and a "Not Deceived" slice in light green (10.5%). Bolded percentage labels are positioned directly inside each corresponding slice, and none of the segments are exploded or visually offset from the main rings. Visually, the segments within both the inner and outer rings are arranged in descending order of size, progressing in a counter-clockwise direction starting from the right side.
